", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0119", "tag": "p", "text": "“Do you remember the scar?” he asked.", "sha256": "2b1a21783e94dc0aa8ca1a343ec0173d8422597da2621d67d01033053d3bdfde", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[347]", "source_html": "

“Do you remember the scar?” he asked.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0120", "tag": "p", "text": "She nodded.", "sha256": "48227c9e068972bd3e8156c10a8fed117e17c15eeda69c6db52f61ff2ca87908", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[348]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0121", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then find it.”", "sha256": "7a5b64954809999371ba11dfc11f8b96f6af2efa2c6acdbc7bb44ce9a2288619", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[349]", "source_html": "

“Then find it.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u005-r0124", "tag": "p", "text": "“That kiss was delightful,” he naughtily disclaimed.", "sha256": "1d00d9dec221c52637ae50e8a680af91b9c591629086a1a94d3eef1d6746652d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[352]", "source_html": "
